results.name: Opening and closing every category writes nothing and leaves required inputs blank
Missing required fields in all six categories block saves with visible errors
All six real forms save supplied values; explicit numeric zero and midnight time are retained
Optional unanswered fields remain null rather than becoming zero or a healthy default
Legacy check-in bytes are preserved and never promoted to a dated personal measurement
Same date/category updates its existing ID while other dates and categories remain byte-equivalent
Out-of-range, negative, fractional whole-number, future date and inconsistent rest-day inputs are rejected
Saved text is restored as text without creating DOM markup or changing a saved zero
Malformed or unsupported storage remains untouched when opening, submitting and exporting
Invalid saved values and duplicate identities cannot be overwritten by a new save
Quota failures preserve the existing store and keep the form open with a failure message
Export includes the complete dated history beyond the 20 entries shown on Home
A storage failure after a successful load clears stale personal summaries and recovers its status
Other-tab removal of an assessment resets its stale saved-date summary
A visible Home rolls over at local midnight without requiring navigation or a new record
Local-day helper follows Singapore, Honolulu and New York dates rather than UTC slicing
Close returns focus to an existing trigger, including after an edited history row is rebuilt

result.scope: Actual HTML/controller in isolated jsdom; no live storage or network. Dialog events are shimmed; native focus containment, layout and screen readers require browser/device verification.

results.name: Empty storage gives explicit empty chart, correct unit choices and no invented point or health write
Changing hormone and reported unit selects only matching records; exact zeros remain visible
Graph x spacing follows collection-date distances and the bar/graph controls update accessible state
Same-date results and all-zero series have finite coordinates and preserve every table row
Values from 1e-308 through 1e308 and Number.MAX_VALUE cannot overflow chart coordinates
Reported bounds retain their original symbols and units and are never plotted as exact concentrations
Original report source and method are visible as inert text, including markup-looking content
Corrupt/null/invalid stores clear an existing chart and table without overwriting any record
View preference survives reload; denied read/write storage leaves usable controls without a false data point
New LH and P4 records round-trip through the real labs save/read API into their matching chart units
Latest-12 limit retains dates and table context without mutating the longer saved history
Ring range input and previous/next controls stay within bounds and expose the example day accessibly
Pointer interaction retains one SVG and listener set; cancelled drags cannot move the ring or schedule stale animation

result.scope: Actual HTML, labs API and display scripts in isolated jsdom. Native range keyboard defaults, pointer capture, SVG layout and assistive-technology announcements still need browser/device checks.

checks: Blank, negative, nonfinite and malformed values are rejected
Zero and report inequalities are retained; follicle counts require whole numbers
Actual valid collection date is required, with no future date or substituted age
Explicit compatible units/symbols are required and values are never converted
Only entered numeric limits are compared; absent/one-sided/bounded results stay explicit
Dated result/source/assay survive reload while legacy snapshot stays byte-for-byte unchanged
New results append; explicit edit updates one record while preserving others and creation time
Malformed or unsupported saved data cannot be overwritten by a new save
Storage read/write failures propagate without modifying prior records
result.scope: Input, storage and arithmetic behavior only; no clinical interpretation or validation

passed: Empty storage shows explicit empty states and no personal health metrics
Actual saved values, comparator, original units, collection dates, journal and v2 snapshots render as text
Invalid numbers, units, impossible dates and fractional AFC are withheld without changing saved records
Corrupt, unsupported and denied storage report unavailable instead of pretending records are empty
Legacy predictions are never read and a v2 record containing a numerical ovarian-age prediction is rejected
Summaries refresh on other-tab updates and back navigation without accumulating duplicate entries
Both pages have one H1, working local destinations, evidence controls and no removed fake metrics/no-op actions
result.limitation: Isolated renderer and static-link checks; not device, clinical or whole-app validation.
